messages:
Priya: Heads up — nightly NetSuite export failed for ~18 invoices with CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND. Quick dig shows Stripe customer IDs truncated in CSV.

billing-bot: nightly-export-job failed: 04:00 UTC - netsuite_api 404 "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND" (export id: ne-2026-03-24-04)

Elena: Found it: csv_writer had `id[:12]` slicing. Someone added it during a prior change.

Raj: That explains orphaned invoices. NetSuite lookup uses full external id so truncated values don't match.

Sam: Can we patch csv_writer to emit full id and pause the job before re-running? Risk of duplicates?

Elena: Patch ready. We should disable the nightly job first to avoid more bad rows. Also add unit test for long ids.

Priya: I've disabled the nightly-export job and opened TICKET-4310: "Truncated customer_ref in nightly NetSuite export". Finance put the 18 invoices on collections hold.

billing-bot: quarantine-queue: 18 messages moved to export-fix-quarantine-2026-03-24.

Raj: Remediation plan: 1) hotfix exporter, 2) run mapping for truncated_ref -> full_id for placeholder customers, 3) re-run export for quarantined invoices, 4) finance to review any created placeholders for reversal/merge.

Priya: Finance will handle top-5 manually. For the rest, we'll need a mapping script and NS admin help.

Sam: I'll coordinate with NetSuite admin and schedule a merge/update window. Also propose adding an e2e test in staging: create invoice with long stripe id and ensure export lookup succeeds.

Elena: Deployed exporter v2.1.3-canary with fix. Added unit test and removed truncation. Canary run: 50 sample exports succeeded.

ops-bot: scheduled-job disabled: nightly-export-job (id: ne-2026-03-24-04) by Priya.

Raj: I'll run dry-run of mapping script in 2h and attach output to TICKET-4310 for finance review.

Priya: Good. Finance will review dry-run and approve merge policy. If merges are needed, Sam please proceed.

Elena: Follow-ups: add lint rule to catch slicing of external ids, add schema check on export rows (customer_ref length), include Stripe id parity in nightly CI.

Sam: Also update runbook: if NetSuite returns CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND on export, quarantine immediately and notify finance.

Priya: Thanks. I'll update the ticket and mark top-5 for manual handling. If CS gets any pings, escalate to me.

Raj: Dry-run attached in ~2h. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
